_what_this_is: the measured closeout of C1 attempt 11, built from the provider and launcher evidence collected beside it.
classification: PROVIDER ACQUISITION FAILURE. The pod was created and billed but never became reachable: no SSH endpoint ever appeared. Setup never started, so this is upstream of every failure mode either earlier attempt had.

what_ran.pre_provider_gates: 14 of 14 passed, twice -- once in a read-only pre-flight that did not invoke the launcher, and again by the launcher itself

the_failure.what_happened: pod udkapuemrwqcmt was created at 11:53:46Z and polled every ~64 s. It reported `starting` for 840 s and no TCP 22 mapping ever appeared. The launcher abandoned the draw at 15.3 min and deleted the pod.
the_failure.independently_corroborated: the out-of-band read-only poll, running in its own tmux session and touching only the provider control plane, recorded desiredStatus RUNNING with `runtime: null` at 11:58:33Z, 12:03:33Z and 12:08:34Z -- three consecutive ticks in which the host had not started -- and an empty inventory at 12:10:31Z. That is independent of anything the launcher claimed.
the_failure.not_a_launcher_defect: the 15-minute bound is the documented rule: `runtime: null` at 15 minutes means the host is not starting, and the correct action is to stop rather than keep paying. It did exactly that.
the_failure.not_addressable_by_repair: nothing in this repository caused it and no change here prevents it. It is a provider-side cold host.
what_it_is_not: not a gate failure: all fourteen passed, at $0 and again at launch
not a setup failure: setup never ran, because there was no host to run it on
not a replay mismatch, not an efficacy observation, not a frozen-rule INCONCLUSIVE

the_structural_exposure_it_reveals.what: C1 launches with --host-draws 1 and --create-attempts 1, because the grant permits exactly ONE provider resource. Every earlier session in this project drew up to three hosts, deleting a cold one and drawing again, precisely because this provider yields unreachable hosts often enough to plan for.
the_structural_exposure_it_reveals.consequence: a condition every other session treated as a retryable draw consumes an entire formal C1 attempt.
evidence_that_it_is_common_here: AutoInit characterization continuation attempt 2: all THREE host draws tripped HOST_COLD in the uv-sync window, $0.6367, produced nothing
AutoInit characterization continuation attempt 1: 29 of 38 minutes were a cold host, abandoned and deleted by the launcher
micro-preflight attempt 4: ~$0.41 of it was a cold first draw, abandoned and deleted
the_structural_exposure_it_reveals.stock_evidence_is_weak: n=1 at Low. Suggestive, not established, and not on its own a basis for spending the last attempt.

teardown_confirmed_three_ways: the launcher deleted the pod at 15.3 min and reported provider_confirms_gone true
the independent out-of-band poll recorded an empty inventory at 2026-09-11T12:10:31Z
the run manifest records provider_confirms_gone true

retry_assessment.eligible_under_the_package: NOT ESTABLISHED -- one condition is not satisfiable by me

conditions.no_formal_probe_training_started: CONFIRMED -- setup never started; there was no host
conditions.ordinary_infrastructure_failure_with_cau: the cause is identified and is ordinary, but it is NOT addressed and cannot be addressed from this repository. The only effective mitigation -- redrawing a host that never became reachable -- requires more than one provider resource per attempt, which this grant forbids. Relaxing that is a scope decision, not a repair.
conditions.count_and_balance_sufficient: 1 attempt and $51.0465 of package remain, which funds one complete attempt

retry_assessment.why_this_stops: the package pre-authorizes retries whose cause has been addressed. Relaunching unchanged would be repeating an identical failure and betting the last of three attempts on a provider lottery. That is a maintainer decision.
